title: Paired cuff-pressure covariance and albuminuria: an exploratory cross-cycle prediction challenge
abstract: Paired within-visit systolic–diastolic BP covariance did not establish incremental cross-cycle albuminuria prediction beyond marginal BP means/SDs, serum creatinine and risk factors: Brier difference -0.000048, joint bootstrap 95% interval [-0.000200, 0.000444].
